name: acne-step0-candidate-verifier-protocol
status: fixed before any TRAIN candidate is labelled, any feature is extracted or any model is fitted; one model family, one finite fit
nature: small learned second stage on FIXED Step0 candidates; YOLOX weights, BatchNorm, scores, candidate generation (product chain, conf .30, NMS .30, unchanged box filter) untouched; offline; acne stays accepted:false; AI engineering labels, not expert

data.manifest: audit-results/acne-v6-data/manifest-v6.json (189 TRAIN photos: 148 positive with 514 kept boxes, 76 with reviewed clean ROI, 41 auxiliary negative photos with reviewed masks)
data.usable: photos with an existing replay row (landmarks + snapshot): all 148 positive + 10 negative; the 31 core negative photos without replay are reported and not used (no new landmark/replay generation)
data.excluded: the 28 DEV photos, 108-target common scope, DEV Clear photos and the sealed test are never used for training or calibration; dHash near-duplicates (<= 10) between TRAIN and DEV/DEV Clear are reported and dropped from TRAIN

candidates: Step0 final candidates of the unchanged label-free chain (eval_acne_v5_independent.run_photo) on each usable TRAIN photo; same run records per-candidate features

labels.r: 0.03 x face width (MediaPipe 234-454, source px) - the evaluation tolerance
labels.positive: candidate centre within r of the centre of a KEPT positive box (engineering-reviewed visible lesion), and not inside an ignore box closer than that kept box
labels.negative: candidate centre inside the reviewed clean ROI (positive photos) or the reviewed negative mask (negative photos), or inside a kept confounder (negativeBoxes) box, and farther than r from every kept/ignore box centre and outside every kept/ignore box
labels.excluded: everything else (unlabelled, ambiguous, conflicting); model consensus is never a label
labels.record: per-candidate decision with reason; small crop + context images kept locally (not in Git)

features.source: frozen Step0 PAFPN outputs of the same tile forward pass that produced the candidate (strides 4, 8, 16, 32; 64/128/256/512 channels)
features.vector: per level: bilinear sample at the candidate centre (tile coordinates) + mean over the cells within +-2 cells of the centre; concatenated (1920 dims); no detector score, no box size, no colour statistic
features.tile: the tile whose >= .30 candidate produced the final box (recorded by the chain); no label-dependent crop or scale
features.check: with feature hooks the final boxes must equal the stored/trace Step0 finals (DEV) and a run without hooks (TRAIN spot check)

split.groups: photo = group (each photo has its own research group); dHash <= 10 near-duplicate photos merged into one group
split.learnCalib: groups shuffled with seed 20261016; 70% learn / 30% calibration by group

model.family: logistic regression with L2 penalty (C = 0.1, class_weight balanced, lbfgs, max_iter 2000)

threshold.rule: on calibration only: the highest probability threshold that keeps >= 95% of calibration positives (ties keep more); not a product accuracy claim
threshold.gate: go to DEV only if calibration AUC >= 0.65 AND the threshold removes >= 15% of calibration negatives; otherwise report non-separation and stop

dev.once: after freezing model, standardizer and threshold: A = Step0 + unchanged box filter (71/108, F96, D48); B = A minus candidates the verifier rejects
dev.scoring: same 108 in-scope targets, frozen layer 1 + reviewed masks, r = 0.03 fw, one-to-one; report found, lost target ids, false, duplicates, uncertain, non-skin, per photo, time and memory
dev.noRecalibration: no threshold or model change after DEV

rights: new classifier weights do not resolve the rights status of Step0 or of the TRAIN data (publisher declarations only)
